reviewScope: Ten physical public-access sites frozen before source research. Decisions distinguish the access-area coordinate from an exact water-entry coordinate and route publication from coordinate status.

sites.name: York Road Gunpowder access

occurrences.endpointName: York Road Gunpowder access

sites.reason: The Maryland DNR source identifies York Road as a river-difficulty boundary and directs paddlers to the Bunker Hill parking area above the river. Other public recreation guidance describes roadside parking at York for fishing/wading; it does not establish a public canoe/kayak landing at this stored pin. Remove this optional point while keeping the independently supported Masemore-to-Monkton route public.

sources.finding: Hereford directions direct visitors to Bunker Hill Road parking; York Road is discussed as a river boundary/difficulty marker, not a paddling launch.
Provides river difficulty and safety information, including the York boundary; no public landing at the selected pin is identified.
Describes roadside parking at York and other crossings for fishing/wading; this does not establish a paddling launch.

sites.reopen: Restore an access point only if Maryland DNR or the land manager confirms a public canoe/kayak landing, legal parking, and a usable carry at this crossing.

sites.name: Jamestown Falls Hand Launch / Landing

occurrences.endpointName: Jamestown Falls Hand Launch / Landing
NYSDEC Jamestown Falls Hand Launch / carry

sites.reason: NYSDEC publishes this coordinate for trailhead parking and says the hand launch is reached by a 100-foot carry. The coordinate is a valid access-area anchor, but the published point does not resolve the actual water-entry edge or whether the proposed take-out is below the falls. Preserve it as an optional route waypoint; hold only the route that depends on it as a terminal take-out.

sources.finding: Publishes the parking coordinate 44.3262,-74.7226 and describes a 100-foot carry to the river; warns of difficult whitewater/portages in the complex.

sites.reopen: Identify the landing below the falls on current DEC mapping or imagery, confirm the public carry, then regenerate and inspect the terminal route geometry.

sites.name: Farm Field Park kayak and canoe access

occurrences.endpointName: Farm Field Park kayak and canoe access
Farm Field Park kayak and canoe access

sites.reason: The City confirms public kayak/canoe access and a boat-launch photo, but its published coordinate identifies the general park. Its amenities GIS query returned a parking lot rather than a launch feature. A separate Google Maps Boat ramp feature linked to the City page is at the riverbank in current satellite imagery. Use it as a mapped launch-area anchor with 100-foot reviewer-estimated uncertainty, not as a surveyed water-edge coordinate.

sources.finding: City park record confirms kayak/canoe access and boat-launch photo, gives 43.5028832,-96.749131 as the general facility location, and lists 5 a.m.–10 p.m. daily hours.
City amenities layer returned a Farm Field parking lot feature, not a water-entry feature.

Boat-ramp POI (place ID 0x878ec90045dc01af:0xb29ff98a93bb23fb) links to the City page; feature coordinate is 43.5013198,-96.7504983. Current satellite imagery corroborates a riverside location, but the precise wet edge is not surveyed.

sites.reopen: Replace the mapped access-area anchor only if the City publishes a launch-specific coordinate or a current georeferenced source resolves the ramp's water-side endpoint more precisely.

sites.name: Heath Canyon / La Linda take-out

occurrences.endpointName: Heath Canyon / La Linda take-out

sites.reason: NPS confirms the Heath Canyon take-out is on the U.S. side just downstream of La Linda bridge; TPWD now owns/operates the take-out and requires a Limited Use Permit and self-registration. TPWD also confirms the 2025 acquisition will continue public river access. The stored American Whitewater point is an access-area anchor about 343 feet from mapped water; no reviewed official source resolves the exact landing or lawful approach. Keep withheld pending georeferencing.

sources.finding: Confirms the 33-mile Rio Grande Village-to-Heath Canyon trip, take-out on the U.S. side downstream of La Linda bridge, TPWD operation and Limited Use Permit/self-registration requirements.
Confirms Heath Canyon access downstream of La Linda and warns that Lower Canyons access is limited, difficult and constrained by private land.
Confirms the 2025 acquisition for Black Gap WMA management and continued public river access; it does not map a landing.
Provides background on access points and ownership; it does not provide a current landing coordinate.

sites.reopen: Obtain a TPWD/NPS map or current georeferenced image that identifies the public take-out landing and approach; verify current permit instructions and regenerate route geometry.
